title: Lorenz Attractor Chaotic Trajectories Visualization
full_prompt: Write a ManimGL script that visualizes the chaotic behavior of the Lorenz Attractor. The scene should set up a 3D coordinate system using ThreeDAxes, scaled to fit the frame, and continuously rotate the camera around the z-axis using a frame updater. Display the system of differential equations in the upper-left corner of the screen, fixed in frame, with variables x, y, and z color-coded in RED, GREEN, and BLUE respectively. Solve the Lorenz system ODEs using scipy's solve_ivp for 10 slightly perturbed initial states (differing by epsilon = 1e-5) to demonstrate chaotic divergence. Generate smooth 3D curves from these solved points, colored with a gradient from dark blue to light blue. Attach glowing dots (GlowDot) and tracing tails (TracingTail) to the trajectories, and animate the curves drawing themselves linearly over a duration of 30 seconds.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing scipy import or integration failure
common_failure_modes.note: The script relies on scipy.integrate.solve_ivp; if scipy is not installed or the ODE solver fails, the scene will crash.

common_failure_modes.pattern: ManimCE vs ManimGL camera API mismatch
common_failure_modes.note: Using self.frame.reorient or self.frame.add_updater in a standard ManimCE environment will raise an AttributeError. Must use ManimGL or translate to ThreeDScene camera methods.
GlowDot and TracingTail are specific to 3b1b's ManimGL fork. In standard ManimCE, they must be substituted with Dot/TracedPath or custom implementations.
